description_short: Links physically separated City Blocks into one shared settlement.
description_long: All player City Blocks share one real vanilla Settlement economy regardless of physical separation. Population, housing, food, water, wastewater, electricity, household goods, appliances, electronics, luxury goods, computing, healthcare, waste, recyclables, biowaste, health, and Unity are evaluated across the combined settlement. Town services and settlement decorations can be placed away from City Blocks. Decorations retain their per-City-Block Unity influence within their native-sized physical square range. Grid snapping can be toggled during City Block, town-service, and decoration placement. Building buffers, pipes, trucks, and logistics remain local and vanilla.
